topics.purpose: Define deterministic recursive membership closure over explicit nested-group edges with cycle handling and no rights multiplication.

semantics.edge_rule: Nested membership uses explicit membership refs.
semantics.closure_rule: Effective membership is deterministic over exact active edges.
semantics.cycle_rule: Cycles do not multiply rights and are surfaced/handled explicitly.
semantics.revocation_rule: Removing a membership edge removes dependent effective membership unless another valid path exists.
semantics.rights_rule: Rights derive only after closure through explicit policy/role binding.
semantics.order_rule: Traversal/file order does not affect effective membership.

invariants.rule: Identity, authentication assurance, authorization policy, authorization decision, delegation and runtime execution remain separate machine-significant identities/evidence; no one layer silently substitutes for another.

Ambiguous, missing, stale or unverifiable authority for a protected effect fails closed rather than inheriting trust from locality, transport reachability, process ownership, UI visibility or previous success.

references.purpose: Closure operates on exact membership edges.
